name: Handy Kit
description: Small client conveniences in one mod. Log viewer (F7): browse latest.log and every dated log by day and by server, search all days, jump from a hit to its place. Macros (M): left and right auto clicker, ten chat presets on keys, keyword auto replies, input recording with playback, unsigned chat. Server tabs (F6): several servers open at once in one client, a tab bar on top, each with its own world, chat and resource packs. Transfers: with ViaFabricPlus, a transfer target is joined with the version that server speaks. Legacy packs: core shaders of 1.21.x resource packs are translated for 26.3, with a vanilla fallback per pipeline.
